entities.summary: Bogdan Jerzy Lis worked in Port of Gdańsk and Elmor company. Between 1971 and 1972 he was imprisoned for his participation in the anti-governmental coastal cities protests. Although in 1975 he joined the Polish United Workers' Party, in 1978 he was one of the founders of the anti-government Free Trade Unions of the Coast.
